tasks.title: Volunteer role preferences
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.subject: Weekend volunteering scheme
paragraphs: As you know, our school is planning a weekend volunteering scheme. We need to choose roles for volunteers. The options are: helping at a local food bank, tidying up a community garden, or assisting at an animal shelter.
Which role would you prefer and why? Also, would you like to volunteer on Saturday or Sunday?
Finally, can you suggest one way to encourage more students to join the scheme?

promptBlocks.heading: Notes for your reply
listItems: Choose a role and say why you chose it.
Say which day you prefer and explain why.
Suggest one way to encourage more students to join.
Ask Mrs. Hill about the transport to the volunteering site.

promptBlocks.text: Write your email to Mrs. Hill using all the notes.

tasks.title: Volunteering article
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: Our school magazine wants to hear about your ideas for the weekend volunteering scheme.
What kind of volunteering do you think is most useful for our community?
How can volunteering help students learn new skills?
Write an article answering these questions and we will put it in the next magazine!

tasks.title: Volunteering story
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: Your English teacher has asked you to write a story.
Your story must begin with this sentence:
"When the programme coordinator handed me the volunteer badge, I had no idea what the weekend would bring."

tasks.scenario: School magazine article about the volunteering scheme's community benefit and skill development.
requiredContentPoints: most useful type of volunteering for community
how volunteering helps students learn skills

tasks.scenario: Story beginning with receiving a volunteer badge and an unexpected weekend.
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Opening sentence is unique: 'volunteer badge' and 'weekend' not used in any existing test. No overlap with Test 01 or any other.
